name: Hot Choco & Marshmallow
source:
After being discharged from the military and returning to college, Chanhyeok aims to achieve two goals: the pleasures of campus life and a sweet romance.

But the partner he meets on a blind date, set up by his department professor, turns out to be the freshman junior Chanhyeok fell in love with at first sight?!

The problem is, as their relationship develops through a series of chaotic dates, he discovers she is actually a "Yandere"...

You must make choices to succeed in a romance with this Yandere, and enjoy the bittersweet tension blooming within.

However, as your encounters increase, heart-pounding situations and accidental happenings with the people around you keep occurring...

Will you be able to stay safe and successfully become lovers with the Yandere by the end of the game?

[From [url=https://store.onstove.com/en/games/103408]STOVE[/url]]
translation:
退伍回到大学后，灿赫的目标有两个：快乐的校园生活和甜蜜的浪漫。

但他相亲时遇到的系教授安排的对象，竟然是大一的灿赫一见钟情？！

问题是，随着他们的关系通过一系列混乱的约会而发展，他发现她实际上是一个“病娇”……

你必须做出选择才能成功地与这个病态的人建立浪漫关系，并享受内心绽放的苦乐参半的紧张气氛。

然而，随着接触的增多，令人心碎的情况和与周围人发生的意外不断发生……

在游戏结束时，你能保持安全并成功与Yandere成为恋人吗？

[来自[url=https://store.onstove.com/en/games/103408]STOVE[/url]]
